accuracy_metric: retrieval fidelity vs baseline ranked doc IDs (pseudo-gold); reranker HTTP 401 for all arms (matches production)
conclusion: At 400 scale the split is sharper than at 25. Accuracy-preserving speedups are harness-level: parallel classify||prep (P) 1.09x at Recall 0.980, and typed-dispatch (separate) 47% at Recall 0.999. App-level model-swap/compact (M2-M4) reach 7-8x but retrieval Recall collapses to 0.33-0.45 and country extraction to ~0.70. Merge on the same model (M1) is a middle point (1.23x, Recall 0.917). Accuracy-preserving engineering = harness-level (remove/parallelize calls), not aggressive app-level substitution.
